crossRefs.note: My son, pay attention to my wisdom. Turn your ear to my understanding,
My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.
Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck.
My son, keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.
Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.
So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

translations.web: My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings.
translations.bsb: My son, pay attention to my words; incline your ear to my sayings.
translations.kjv: My son, attend to my words; incline thine ear unto my sayings.
translations.asv: My son, attend to my words; Incline thine ear unto my sayings.
